attributes.name: Strength
attributes.desc: Raw physical power, melee damage, lifting, and heavy weapon handling.

attributes.name: Dexterity
attributes.desc: Coordination, speed, fine motor control, stealth, and reflexes.

attributes.name: Constitution
attributes.desc: Physical toughness, stamina, resistance, and base HP.

attributes.name: Intelligence
attributes.desc: Logical reasoning, technical knowledge, hacking and medical science.

attributes.name: Wisdom
attributes.desc: Street survival instincts, situational awareness, perception, and intuition.

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.desc: Social influence, persuasion, deception, leadership, and street dealing.

attributes.name: Mental Strength
attributes.desc: Psychological resilience, stress endurance, willpower under pressure.

attributes.name: Credit Score
attributes.desc: Your economic footprint, access to legitimate services, and societal standing.

crs.note: Lowering CRS at creation refunds points; it can never be raised above 20 at creation.
